guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice shows the largest anomaly (latency-50 +3573%, z=+714) and is the most downstream service among the affected ones (recommendationservice and frontend latencies rise after it). Its socket count jumped from 5 to 47.7 (+854%), a much larger change than its cpu (+418%) or mem (+236%), though cpu and mem also rose, so socket is the best fit but not unambiguous; logs contain no errors and traces show no error spans.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice's open connections and connection handling (leaks, pool limits, stuck sockets). If connections are confirmed stuck, restart or roll the productcatalogservice pods after verifying other replicas can absorb the load. Check node conntrack usage as a secondary lead.
